toegepas.voor: Gras groei in die veld en 'n springbok
toegepas.na: Gras groei in die veld, en 'n springbok
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses (Gras groei / 'n springbok vreet).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both clauses have their own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Gras groei langs die water en 'n sprinkaan
toegepas.na: Gras groei langs die water, en 'n sprinkaan
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses (Gras groei / 'n sprinkaan vreet).

toegepas.voor: 'n Deel van sy kos gaan onverteer uit.
toegepas.na: 'n Deel van sy kos verlaat sy lyf onverteer.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'gaan uit' reads unnaturally here and can suggest 'goes out' like a fire; the replacement says the same thing plainly.
toegepas.fout: 'gaan onverteer uit' is vague and unnatural; it does not say what the food leaves.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal says plainly that undigested food leaves the animal's body, the same claim in natural Afrikaans, and 'sy' still points to the animal.

toegepas.voor: Dus bly daar minder oor vir die volgende dier.
toegepas.na: Daar bly dus minder oor vir die volgende dier.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Sentence-initial 'Dus' is stiff; mid-sentence 'dus' is the natural Afrikaans placement and matches the lesson's own 'kom dus van'.
toegepas.fout: Sentence-initial 'Dus' reads stiff and bookish for a Grade 5 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Mid-sentence 'dus' is the natural placement, matches the lesson's earlier 'kom dus van', and changes nothing in the meaning.
